translations.idiomatic: East and west side gates, Duan, Grand Marshal, East and West Hua, Chenming, Great Pass and other gates, each also two companies, and three hall-guard companies—though imperial travel did not follow, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 又有八馬遊盪、馬左右夾轂、左右馬百騎等各二隊，及騎官、閱武馬容、雜伎馬容及左右馬騎直隊，行則侍衞左右，分為警衞。

translations.literal: Also had eight-horse wanderers, horse left and right flank-guard, left and right horse hundred riders each two companies, and cavalry officer, military review horse guard, miscellaneous performer horse guard and left and right horse cavalry direct companies—when traveling attended left and right, divided as alert guard.
translations.idiomatic: Also, had eight-horse wanderers, horse left and right flank-guard, left and right horse hundred riders each two companies, and cavalry officer, military review horse guard, miscellaneous performer horse guard and left and right horse cavalry direct companies—when traveling attended left and right, divided as alert guard.

sentences.zh: 車駕晨夜出入及涉險，皆作函。

translations.literal: Imperial carriage morning and night entering and exiting and crossing danger, all made enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial carriage morning and night entering and exiting and crossing danger, all made enclosure, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 鹵簿應宿衞軍騎，皆執兵持滿，各當其所保護方面。

translations.literal: Guard of honor corresponding to palace guard army and cavalry all held weapons drawn full, each at their protected direction.
translations.idiomatic: Guard of honor corresponding to palace guard army and cavalry all held weapons drawn full, each at their protected direction, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 天明及度險，乃奏解函，撾鼓而依常列。

translations.literal: At dawn and crossing danger, then reported release enclosure, beat drums and follow normal formation.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn and crossing danger, then reported release enclosure, beat drums and follow normal formation, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 乘輿行則有大駕、法駕、小駕。

translations.literal: When imperial carriage traveled there were great carriage, law carriage, and small carriage.
translations.idiomatic: When imperial carriage traveled there were great carriage, law carriage, and small carriage, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 大駕以郊饗上天，臨馭九伐。

translations.literal: Great carriage for suburban sacrifice ascending Heaven, commanding nine punitive campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: Great carriage for suburban sacrifice ascending Heaven, commanding nine punitive campaigns, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 法駕以祭方澤，祀明堂，奉宗廟，藉千畝。

translations.literal: Law carriage for sacrificing at Square Pond, Bright Hall, ancestral temple, plowing thousand-mu field.
translations.idiomatic: Law carriage for sacrificing at Square Pond, Bright Hall, ancestral temple, plowing thousand-mu field, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 小駕以敬園陵，親蒐狩。

translations.literal: Small carriage for reverencing imperial tombs, personally hunting.
translations.idiomatic: Small carriage for reverencing imperial tombs, personally hunting, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 大駕則公卿奉引，大將軍驂乘，太僕馭。

translations.literal: Great carriage: dukes and ministers led, Grand General rode beside, Grand Master of Carriages drove.
translations.idiomatic: Great carriage: dukes and ministers led, Grand General rode beside, Grand Master of Carriages drove, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 法駕小駕，皆侍中驂乘，奉車郎馭，公卿不引。

translations.literal: Law carriage and small carriage: all Palace Attendant rode beside, Director of Carriages drove, dukes and ministers did not lead.
translations.idiomatic: Law carriage and small carriage: all Palace Attendant rode beside, Director of Carriages drove, dukes and ministers did not lead, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其餘行幸，送往勞旋，則槊仗。

translations.literal: Other imperial travels, sending off and welcoming return, then spear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Other imperial travels, sending off and welcoming return, then spear guard, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 近讌則隊仗。

translations.literal: Near banquets then company guard.
translations.idiomatic: Near banquets then company guard, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 三駕法天，二仗法地，其動也參天而兩地也。

translations.literal: Three carriages pattern Heaven, two guards pattern Earth—their movement participates Heaven and pairs Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Three carriages pattern Heaven, two guards pattern Earth—their movement participates Heaven and pairs Earth, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 陳氏承梁，亦無改革。

translations.literal: Chen inherited Liang, also no reform.
translations.idiomatic: Chen inherited Liang, also no reform, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 齊文宣受禪之後，警衞多循後魏之儀。

translations.literal: After Emperor Wenxuan of Qi received mandate, palace guard mostly followed Later Wei ritual.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wenxuan of Qi received mandate, palace guard mostly followed Later Wei ritual, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 及河清中定令，宮衞之制，左右各有羽林郎十二隊。

translations.literal: Reaching Heqing period fixed regulations, palace guard system: left and right each had Feathered Forest Commanders twelve companies.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Heqing period fixed regulations, palace guard system: left and right each had Feathered Forest Commanders twelve companies, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 又有持鈒隊、鋋槊隊、長刀隊、細仗隊，楯鎩隊、雄戟隊、格獸隊、赤氅隊、角抵隊、羽林隊、步遊盪隊、馬遊盪隊。

translations.literal: Also had blade-bearing company, spear-pike company, long sword company, fine guard company, shield-spear company, great-halberd company, beast-wrestling company, red cloak company, wrestling company, Feathered Forest company, foot wanderer company, horse wanderer company.
translations.idiomatic: Also, had blade-bearing company, spear-pike company, long sword company, fine guard company, shield-spear company, great-halberd company, beast-wrestling company, red cloak company, wrestling company, Feathered Forest company, foot wanderer company, horse wanderer company.

sentences.zh: 又左右各武賁十隊，左右翊各四隊，又步遊盪、馬遊盪左右各三隊，是為武賁。

translations.literal: Also left and right each ten Martial Tiger companies, left and right flank each four companies, also foot and horse wanderers left and right each three companies—these were Martial Tiger.
translations.idiomatic: Also, left and right each ten Martial Tiger companies, left and right flank each four companies, also foot and horse wanderers left and right each three companies—these were Martial Tiger.

sentences.zh: 又有直從武賁，左右各六隊，在左者為前驅隊，在右者為後拒隊。

translations.literal: Also had direct-attendant Martial Tiger, left and right each six companies—those on left were vanguard company, on right rear guard company.
translations.idiomatic: Also, had direct-attendant Martial Tiger, left and right each six companies—those on left were vanguard company, on right rear guard company.

sentences.zh: 又有募員武賁隊、強弩隊，左右各一隊，在左者皆左衞將軍總之，在右者皆右衞將軍總之，以備警衞。

translations.literal: Also had recruited Martial Tiger company, strong crossbow company, left and right each one company—left all commanded by Left Guard General, right by Right Guard General, to prepare alert guard.
translations.idiomatic: Also, had recruited Martial Tiger company, strong crossbow company, left and right each one company—left all commanded by Left Guard General, right by Right Guard General, to prepare alert guard.

sentences.zh: 其領軍、中領將軍，侍從出入，則著兩襠甲，手執檉杖。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief and Central Commander-in-Chief, attending entering and exiting, wore double-breastplate armor, hand held catalpa staff.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief and Central Commander-in-Chief, attending entering and exiting, wore double-breastplate armor, hand held catalpa staff, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右衞將軍、將軍則兩襠甲，手執檀杖。

translations.literal: Left and Right Guard Generals and generals wore double-breastplate armor, hand held sandalwood staff.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Guard Generals and generals wore double-breastplate armor, hand held sandalwood staff, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 侍從左右，則有千牛備身、左右備身、刀劍備身之屬。

translations.literal: Attending left and right, had Thousand-Ox Bodyguard, Left and Right Bodyguard, Sword Bodyguard types.
translations.idiomatic: Attending left and right, had Thousand-Ox Bodyguard, Left and Right Bodyguard, Sword Bodyguard types, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 兼有武威、熊渠、鷹揚等備身三隊，皆領左右將軍主之，宿衞左右，而戎服執仗。

translations.literal: Also had Martial Might, Xiongqu, Eagle-Rising and other bodyguard three companies, all commanded by Left and Right Guard Generals, night guard left and right, in military dress holding weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Also, had Martial Might, Xiongqu, Eagle-Rising and other bodyguard three companies, all commanded by Left and Right Guard Generals, night guard left and right, in military dress holding weapons.

sentences.zh: 兵有斧鉞弓箭刀矟，旌旗皆囊首，五色節文，斾悉赭黃。

translations.literal: Weapons had axe, bow and arrow, sword, spear; banners all bagged heads, five-color patterned streamers, pennants all ochre-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Weapons had axe, bow and arrow, sword, spear; banners all bagged heads, five-color patterned streamers, pennants all ochre-yellow, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 天子御正殿，唯大臣夾侍，兵仗悉在殿下。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven at main hall, only great ministers flanked attendance; weapons all below hall.
translations.idiomatic: Son of Heaven at main hall, only great ministers flanked attendance; weapons all below hall, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 郊祭鹵簿，則督將平巾幘，緋衫甲，大口袴。

translations.literal: Suburban sacrifice guard of honor: commanders flat zé headcloth, crimson jacket armor, wide trousers.
translations.idiomatic: Suburban sacrifice guard of honor: commanders flat zé headcloth, crimson jacket armor, wide trousers, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 後周警衞之制，置左右宮伯，掌侍衞之禁，各更直於內。

translations.literal: Later Zhou palace guard system: placed Left and Right Palace Chiefs, managing attendance guard prohibitions, each alternating duty within.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou palace guard system: placed Left and Right Palace Chiefs, managing attendance guard prohibitions, each alternating duty within, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 小宮伯貳之。

translations.literal: Assistant Palace Chiefs assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Palace Chiefs assisted them, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 臨朝則分在前侍之首，並金甲，各執龍環金飾長刀。

translations.literal: At court audience divided before front attendants heads, all gold armor, each held dragon-ring gold-ornament long sword.
translations.idiomatic: At court audience divided before front attendants heads, all gold armor, each held dragon-ring gold-ornament long sword, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 行則夾路車。

translations.literal: When traveling flanked the road chariot.
translations.idiomatic: When traveling flanked the road chariot, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右中侍，掌御寢之禁，皆金甲，左執龍環，右執獸環長刀，並飾以金。

translations.literal: Left and Right Central Attendants, managing imperial bedchamber prohibitions, all gold armor, left held dragon ring, right beast ring long sword, all ornamented with gold.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Central Attendants, managing imperial bedchamber prohibitions, all gold armor, left held dragon ring, right beast ring long sword, all ornamented with gold, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 次左右侍，陪中侍之後，並銀甲，左執鳳環，右執麟環長刀。

translations.literal: Next Left and Right Attendants, accompanying Central Attendants behind, all silver armor, left phoenix ring, right qilin ring long sword.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the Left and Right Attendants, accompanying Central Attendants behind, all silver armor, left phoenix ring, right qilin ring long sword.

sentences.zh: 次左右前侍，掌御寢南門之左右，並銀甲，左執師子環，右執象環長刀。

translations.literal: Next Left and Right Front Attendants, managing imperial bedchamber south gate left and right, all silver armor, left lion ring, right elephant ring long sword.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the Left and Right Front Attendants, managing imperial bedchamber south gate left and right, all silver armor, left lion ring, right elephant ring long sword.

sentences.zh: 次左右後侍，掌御寢北門之左右，並銀甲，左執犀環，右執兕環長刀。

translations.literal: Next Left and Right Rear Attendants, managing imperial bedchamber north gate left and right, all silver armor, left rhinoceros ring, right wild buffalo ring long sword.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the Left and Right Rear Attendants, managing imperial bedchamber north gate left and right, all silver armor, left rhinoceros ring, right wild buffalo ring long sword.

sentences.zh: 左右騎侍，立於寢之東西階，並銀甲，左執羆環，右執熊環長刀，十二人，兼執師子彤楯，列左右侍之外。

translations.literal: Left and Right Cavalry Attendants, standing at bedchamber east and west steps, all silver armor, left bear ring, right bear ring long sword, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Cavalry Attendants, standing at bedchamber east and west steps, all silver armor, left bear ring, right bear ring long sword, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Attendants, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 自左右侍以下，刀並以銀飾。

translations.literal: From Left and Right Attendants downward, swords all silver ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from Left and Right Attendants downward, swords all silver ornament.

sentences.zh: 左右宗侍，陪左右前侍之後，夜則衞於寢庭之中。

translations.literal: Left and Right Clan Attendants, accompanying Left and Right Front Attendants behind, at night guarded bedchamber courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Clan Attendants, accompanying Left and Right Front Attendants behind, at night guarded bedchamber courtyard, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 皆服金塗甲，左執豹環，右執貔環長刀，並金塗飾，十二人，兼執師子彤楯，列於左右騎侍之外。

translations.literal: All wore gold-coated armor, left leopard ring, right pixiu ring long sword, all gold-coated ornament, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Cavalry Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: All of the wore gold-coated armor, left leopard ring, right pixiu ring long sword, all gold-coated ornament, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Cavalry Attendants.

sentences.zh: 自左右中侍已下，皆行則兼帶黃弓矢，巡田則常服，帶短刀，如其長刀之飾。

translations.literal: From Left and Right Central Attendants downward, when traveling all also carried yellow bow and arrows; on patrol ordinary dress, carried short sword, like their long sword ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from Left and Right Central Attendants downward, when traveling all also carried yellow bow and arrows; on patrol ordinary dress, carried short sword, like their long sword ornament.

sentences.zh: 左右庶侍，掌非皇帝所御門閤之禁，並服金塗甲，左執解豸環，右執獜環長劍，並金飾，十二人，兼執師子彤楯，列於左右宗侍之外。

translations.literal: Left and Right Common Attendants, managing gates not used by emperor, all gold-coated armor, left xiezhi ring, right monkey ring long sword, all gold ornament, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Clan Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Common Attendants, managing gates not used by emperor, all gold-coated armor, left xiezhi ring, right monkey ring long sword, all gold ornament, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Clan Attendants, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 行則兼帶皓弓矢。

translations.literal: When traveling also carried white bow and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: When traveling also carried white bow and arrows, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右勳侍，掌陪左右庶侍而守出入，則服金塗甲，左執吉良環，右執猙環長劍，十二人，兼執師子彤楯，列於左右庶侍之外。

translations.literal: Left and Right Meritorious Attendants, managing accompanying Left and Right Common Attendants guarding entry and exit, wore gold-coated armor, left jiliang ring, right zheng ring long sword, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Common Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Meritorious Attendants, managing accompanying Left and Right Common Attendants guarding entry and exit, wore gold-coated armor, left jiliang ring, right zheng ring long sword, twelve men, also held lion red shields, arrayed outside Left and Right Common Attendants, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 行則兼帶盧弓矢，巡田則與左右庶侍，俱常服，佩短劍，如其長劍之飾。

translations.literal: When traveling also carried black bow and arrows; on patrol with Left and Right Common Attendants, all ordinary dress, wore short sword, like their long sword ornament.
translations.idiomatic: When traveling also carried black bow and arrows; on patrol with Left and Right Common Attendants, all ordinary dress, wore short sword, like their long sword ornament, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 諸侍官，大駕則俱侍，中駕及露寢半之，小駕三分之一。

translations.literal: All attendant officials: great carriage all attended; medium carriage and open bedchamber half; small carriage one third.
translations.idiomatic: All of the attendant officials: great carriage all attended; medium carriage and open bedchamber half; small carriage one third.

sentences.zh: 左右武伯，掌內外衞之禁令，兼六率之士。

translations.literal: Left and Right Martial Chiefs, managing inner and outer guard prohibitions, also commanding six rate soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Martial Chiefs, managing inner and outer guard prohibitions, also commanding six rate soldiers, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 皇帝臨軒，則備三仗於庭，服金甲，執金釦杖，立於殿上東西階之側。

translations.literal: Emperor at imperial throne, then prepared three guards in courtyard, wore gold armor, held gold-buckle staff, standing at hall east and west steps sides.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor at imperial throne, then prepared three guards in courtyard, wore gold armor, held gold-buckle staff, standing at hall east and west steps sides, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 行則列兵於帝之左右，從則服金甲，被繡袍。

translations.literal: When traveling arrayed soldiers at emperor left and right; when following wore gold armor, wore embroidered robe.
translations.idiomatic: When traveling arrayed soldiers at emperor left and right; when following wore gold armor, wore embroidered robe, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右小武伯各二人，貳之，服執同於武伯，分立於大武伯下及露門之左右塾。

translations.literal: Left and Right Small Martial Chiefs two each, assisted them, dress and duty same as Martial Chiefs, standing below Great Martial Chiefs and at Open Gate left and right side halls.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Small Martial Chiefs two each, assisted them, dress and duty same as Martial Chiefs, standing below Great Martial Chiefs and at Open Gate left and right side halls, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 行幸則加錦袍。

translations.literal: On imperial travel added brocade robe.
translations.idiomatic: On imperial travel added brocade robe, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右武賁，率掌武賁之士，其隊器服皆玄，以四色飾之，各總左右持鈒之隊。

translations.literal: Left and Right Martial Tiger Commanders commanded Martial Tiger soldiers, company weapons and dress all black, four colors as ornament, each commanded left and right blade-bearing companies.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Martial Tiger Commanders commanded Martial Tiger soldiers, company weapons and dress all black, four colors as ornament, each commanded left and right blade-bearing companies, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 皇帝臨露寢，則立於左右三仗第一行之南北。

translations.literal: Emperor at open bedchamber, stood at left and right three guards first row north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor at open bedchamber, stood at left and right three guards first row north and south, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 出則分在隊之先後。

translations.literal: When exiting divided before and after companies.
translations.idiomatic: When exiting divided before and after companies, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其副率貳之。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders assisted them, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右旅賁，率掌旅賁士，其隊器服皆青，以朱為飾，立於三仗第二行之南北。

translations.literal: Left and Right Travel Tiger Commanders commanded Travel Tiger soldiers, company weapons and dress all green, vermilion as ornament, stood at three guards second row north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Travel Tiger Commanders commanded Travel Tiger soldiers, company weapons and dress all green, vermilion as ornament, stood at three guards second row north and south, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其副率貳之。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders assisted them, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右射聲，率掌射聲之士，其器服皆朱，以黃為飾，立於三仗第三行之南北。

translations.literal: Left and Right Archery Sound Commanders commanded Archery Sound soldiers, weapons and dress all vermilion, yellow as ornament, stood at three guards third row north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Archery Sound Commanders commanded Archery Sound soldiers, weapons and dress all vermilion, yellow as ornament, stood at three guards third row north and south, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其副率貳之。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders assisted them, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右驍騎，率掌驍騎之士，器服皆黃，以皓為飾，立於三仗第四行之南北。

translations.literal: Left and Right Valiant Cavalry Commanders commanded Valiant Cavalry soldiers, weapons and dress all yellow, white as ornament, stood at three guards fourth row north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Valiant Cavalry Commanders commanded Valiant Cavalry soldiers, weapons and dress all yellow, white as ornament, stood at three guards fourth row north and south, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其副率貳之。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders assisted them, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右羽林，率掌羽林之士，其隊器服皆皓，以玄為飾，立於三仗第五行之南北。

translations.literal: Left and Right Feathered Forest Commanders commanded Feathered Forest soldiers, company weapons and dress all white, black as ornament, stood at three guards fifth row north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Feathered Forest Commanders commanded Feathered Forest soldiers, company weapons and dress all white, black as ornament, stood at three guards fifth row north and south, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其副率貳之。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders assisted them, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右遊擊，率掌遊擊之士，其器服皆玄，以青為飾。

translations.literal: Left and Right Wandering Strike Commanders commanded Wandering Strike soldiers, weapons and dress all black, green as ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Wandering Strike Commanders commanded Wandering Strike soldiers, weapons and dress all black, green as ornament, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其副率貳之。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders assisted them, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 武賁已下六率，通服金甲師子文袍，執銀釦檀杖。

translations.literal: From Martial Tiger downward six rates, generally wore gold armor lion-pattern robe, held silver-buckle sandalwood staff.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from Martial Tiger downward six rates, generally wore gold armor lion-pattern robe, held silver-buckle sandalwood staff.

sentences.zh: 副率通服金甲獸文袍。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders generally wore gold armor beast-pattern robe.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders generally wore gold armor beast-pattern robe, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 各有倅長、帥長，相次陪列。

translations.literal: Each had squad leader and company leader, successively accompanying in array.
translations.idiomatic: Each had squad leader and company leader, successively accompanying in array, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 行則引前。

translations.literal: When traveling led in front.
translations.idiomatic: When traveling led in front, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 倅長通服銀甲豹文袍，帥長通服銀甲鶡文袍。

translations.literal: Squad leaders generally wore silver armor leopard-pattern robe; company leaders silver armor pheasant-pattern robe.
translations.idiomatic: Squad leaders generally wore silver armor leopard-pattern robe; company leaders silver armor pheasant-pattern robe, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 自副率已下，通執獸環銀飾長刀。

translations.literal: From deputy commanders downward, all held beast-ring silver-ornament long sword.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from deputy commanders downward, all held beast-ring silver-ornament long sword.

sentences.zh: 凡大駕則盡行，中駕及露寢則半之，小駕半中駕。

translations.literal: For great carriage all deployed; medium carriage and open bedchamber half; small carriage half of medium carriage.
translations.idiomatic: For great carriage all deployed; medium carriage and open bedchamber half; small carriage half of medium carriage, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 常行軍旅，則衣色尚烏。

translations.literal: On ordinary military travel, dress color honored black.
translations.idiomatic: On ordinary military travel, dress color honored black, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 高祖受命，因周、齊宮衞，微有變革。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu received mandate, following Zhou and Qi palace guard, slightly reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu received mandate, following Zhou and Qi palace guard, slightly reformed, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 戎服臨朝大仗，則領左右大將軍二人，分在左右廂。

translations.literal: Military dress at court great guard: Commanders of Left and Right Guard two men, divided at left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: Military dress at court great guard: Commanders of Left and Right Guard two men, divided at left and right wings, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右直寢、左右直齋、左右直後、千牛備身、左右備身等，夾侍供奉於左右及坐後。

translations.literal: Left and Right Direct Quarters, Direct Fast, Direct Rear, Thousand-Ox Bodyguard, Left and Right Bodyguard and the like, flanked attendance and served left and right and behind seat.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Direct Quarters, Direct Fast, Direct Rear, Thousand-Ox Bodyguard, Left and Right Bodyguard and the like, flanked attendance and served left and right and behind seat, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右衞大將軍、左右直閤將軍、以次左右衞將軍，各領儀刀，為十二行。

translations.literal: Left and Right Guard Grand Generals, Left and Right Direct Attendant Generals, and in order Left and Right Guard Generals, each led ceremonial swords, forming twelve rows.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Guard Grand Generals, Left and Right Direct Attendant Generals, and in order Left and Right Guard Generals, each led ceremonial swords, forming twelve rows, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 內四行親衞，行別以大都督領。

translations.literal: Inner four rows intimate guard, each row commanded by Great Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Inner four rows intimate guard, each row commanded by Great Commander, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 次外四行勳衞，以帥都督領。

translations.literal: Next outer four rows meritorious guard, commanded by Company Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the outer four rows meritorious guard, commanded by Company Commander.

sentences.zh: 次外四行翊衞，以都督領。

translations.literal: Next outer four rows flank guard, commanded by Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the outer four rows flank guard, commanded by Commander.

sentences.zh: 行各二人執金花師子楯、猨刀。

translations.literal: Each row two men held gold-flower lion shield, gibbons sword.
translations.idiomatic: Each row two men held gold-flower lion shield, gibbons sword, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 一百四十人，分左右，帶橫刀。

translations.literal: One hundred forty men, divided left and right, wearing horizontal sword.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred forty men, divided left and right, wearing horizontal sword, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 後監門直長十二人，左青龍旗，右白獸旗。

translations.literal: Rear Gate Guard Direct Chiefs twelve men, left Azure Dragon banner, right White Beast banner.
translations.idiomatic: Rear Gate Guard Direct Chiefs twelve men, left Azure Dragon banner, right White Beast banner, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 左右武衞開府，各領三仗六行，在大仗內，行別六十人，大都督一人領之，帥都督一人後之。

translations.literal: Left and Right Martial Guard Commanders, each led three guard six rows, within great guard, each row sixty men, one Great Commander led, one Company Commander followed.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Martial Guard Commanders, each led three guard six rows, within great guard, each row sixty men, one Great Commander led, one Company Commander followed, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 大駕則執黃麾仗。

translations.literal: Great carriage then held yellow banner guard.
translations.idiomatic: Great carriage then held yellow banner guard, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其次戟二十四，左青龍幢，右白獸幢，䍐、畢各一，鈒金二十四，金節十二道，蓋獸，又絳引幡，朱幢，為持鈒前隊，應蹕，大都督二人領之，在御前橫街南。

translations.literal: Next halberds twenty-four, left Azure Dragon pennant, right White Beast pennant, feather and net each one, gold blade twenty-four, gold node twelve sections, canopy beasts, also crimson guide banners, vermilion pennants, as blade-bearing vanguard company, responding to imperial progress, two Great Commanders led, before imperial carriage at cross street south.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the halberds twenty-four, left Azure Dragon pennant, right White Beast pennant, feather and net each one, gold blade twenty-four, gold node twelve sections, canopy beasts, also crimson guide banners, vermilion pennants, as blade-bearing vanguard company, responding to imperial progress, two Great Commanders led, before imperial carriage at cross street south.

sentences.zh: 左右武衞大將軍，領大仗左右廂，各六行，行別三百六十人，大都督一人領之。

translations.literal: Left and Right Martial Guard Grand Generals, led great guard left and right wings, each six rows, each row three hundred sixty men, one Great Commander led.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Martial Guard Grand Generators, led great guard left and right wings, each six rows, each row three hundred sixty men, one Great Commander led.

sentences.zh: 及大業四年，煬帝北巡出塞，行宮設六合城。

translations.literal: Reaching Daye fourth year, Emperor Yang north toured beyond the frontier, traveling palace set Six Harmonies city.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Daye fourth year, Emperor Yang north toured beyond the frontier, traveling palace set Six Harmonies city, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 方一百二十步，高四丈二尺。

translations.literal: Square one hundred twenty paces, height four zhang two chi.
translations.idiomatic: Square one hundred twenty paces, height four zhang two chi, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 六合，以木為之，方六尺，外面一方有板，離合為之，塗以青色。

translations.literal: Six Harmonies: made of wood, square six chi, each outer face one board, joined and separated, painted green.
translations.idiomatic: Six Harmonies: made of wood, square six chi, each outer face one board, joined and separated, painted green, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 壘六板為城，高三丈六尺，上加女牆板，高六尺。

translations.literal: Stacked six boards as wall, height three zhang six chi, above added parapet boards, height six chi.
translations.idiomatic: Stacked six boards as wall, height three zhang six chi, above added parapet boards, height six chi, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 開南北門。

translations.literal: Opened south and north gates.
translations.idiomatic: Opened south and north gates, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 又於城四角起樓敵二，門觀、門樓檻皆丹青綺畫。

translations.literal: Also at city four corners raised watchtower enemies two, gate towers and gate tower railings all cinnabar and green painted.
translations.idiomatic: Also, at city four corners raised watchtower enemies two, gate towers and gate tower railings all cinnabar and green painted.

sentences.zh: 又造六合殿、千人帳，載以槍車，車載六合三板。

translations.literal: Also made Six Harmonies Hall, thousand-man tent, carried on spear-chariots, chariot carried Six Harmonies three boards.
translations.idiomatic: Also, made Six Harmonies Hall, thousand-man tent, carried on spear-chariots, chariot carried Six Harmonies three boards.

sentences.zh: 其車軨解合交叉，即為馬槍。

translations.literal: Its chariot wheel hubs joined and crossed, immediately became horse spears.
translations.idiomatic: Its chariot wheel hubs joined and crossed, immediately became horse spears, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 每車上張幕，幕下張平一弩，傅矢，五人更守。

translations.literal: Each chariot above stretched awning, under awning stretched level-one crossbow, fitted arrows, five men alternately guarding.
translations.idiomatic: Each chariot above stretched awning, under awning stretched level-one crossbow, fitted arrows, five men alternately guarding, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 兩車之間，施車軨馬槍，皆外其轅，以為外圍。

translations.literal: Between two chariots, deployed chariot hub horse spears, all outer axles outward, as outer enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Between two chariots, deployed chariot hub horse spears, all outer axles outward, as outer enclosure, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 次內布鐵菱，次內施蟄鞬。

translations.literal: Next inner deployed iron caltrops, next inner deployed hidden crossbows.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the inner deployed iron caltrops, next inner deployed hidden crossbows.

sentences.zh: 每一蟄鞬，中施弩牀，長六尺，闊三尺。

translations.literal: Each hidden crossbow, within deployed crossbow bed, length six chi, width three chi.
translations.idiomatic: Each hidden crossbow, within deployed crossbow bed, length six chi, width three chi, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 牀桄陛插鋼錐，皆長五寸，謂之蝦鬚。

translations.literal: Bed frame steps inserted steel spikes, all length five cun, called shrimp whiskers.
translations.idiomatic: Bed frame steps inserted steel spikes, all length five cun, called shrimp whiskers, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 皆施機關，張則錐皆外向。

translations.literal: All had mechanisms; when drawn spikes all faced outward.
translations.idiomatic: All of the had mechanisms; when drawn spikes all faced outward.

sentences.zh: 其牀上施旋機弩，以繩連弩機，人從外來，觸繩則弩機旋轉，向觸所而發。

translations.literal: Its bed above deployed rotating mechanism crossbow, using cord linked crossbow mechanism—when person came from outside and touched cord, crossbow mechanism rotated, fired toward what was touched.
translations.idiomatic: Its bed above deployed rotating mechanism crossbow, using cord linked crossbow mechanism—when person came from outside and touched cord, crossbow mechanism rotated, fired toward what was touched, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 其外又以矰周圍行宮，二丈一鈴一柱，柱舉矰，去地二尺五寸。

translations.literal: Outside again used arrows surrounding traveling palace, one bell one post every two zhang, post raised arrow, two chi five cun from ground.
translations.idiomatic: Outside again used arrows surrounding traveling palace, one bell one post every two zhang, post raised arrow, two chi five cun from ground, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 當行宮南北門，施槌磬，連矰，以機發之。

translations.literal: At traveling palace south and north gates, deployed hammer chime, linked arrows, triggered by mechanism.
translations.idiomatic: At traveling palace south and north gates, deployed hammer chime, linked arrows, triggered by mechanism, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 有人觸矰，則眾鈴發響，槌擊兩磬，以知所警，名為擊警。

translations.literal: When someone touched arrow, all bells sounded, hammer struck two chimes, to know what was alerted—called strike alert.
translations.idiomatic: When someone touched arrow, all bells sounded, hammer struck two chimes, to know what was alerted—called strike alert, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 八年征遼，又造鉤陳，以木板連如帳子。

translations.literal: Eighth year campaign against Liao, also made Hook Formation, wooden boards linked like tent.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year campaign against Liao, also made Hook Formation, wooden boards linked like tent, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 張之則綺文，卷之則直焉。

translations.literal: When stretched had patterned brocade; when rolled was straight.
translations.idiomatic: When stretched had patterned brocade; when rolled was straight, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 帝御營與賊城相對，夜中設六合城，周廻八里。

translations.literal: Emperor imperial camp opposite enemy city, at night set Six Harmonies city, circuit eight li.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor imperial camp opposite enemy city, at night set Six Harmonies city, circuit eight li, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 城及女垣，合高十仞，上布甲士，立仗建旗。

translations.literal: Wall and parapet combined height ten ren, above deployed armored soldiers, standing weapons raised banners.
translations.idiomatic: Wall and parapet combined height ten ren, above deployed armored soldiers, standing weapons raised banners, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 又四隅有闕，面別一觀，觀下開三門。

translations.literal: Also four corners had towers, each face one pavilion, below pavilion opened three gates.
translations.idiomatic: Also, four corners had towers, each face one pavilion, below pavilion opened three gates.

sentences.zh: 其中施行殿，殿上容侍臣及三衞仗，合六百人。

translations.literal: Within executed hall, hall accommodated attendant ministers and Three Guard weapon guard, combined six hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Within executed hall, hall accommodated attendant ministers and Three Guard weapon guard, combined six hundred men, in the established manner.

sentences.zh: 一宿而畢，望之若真，高麗旦忽見，謂之為神焉。

translations.literal: One night and completed; viewed from afar seemed real—Goguryeo at dawn suddenly saw it, called it divine.
translations.idiomatic: One night and completed; viewed from afar seemed real—Goguryeo at dawn suddenly saw it, called it divine, in the established manner.
